definitions.comparison_scope: same parent object, policy, prefix, and readout role
definitions.inference: descriptive only; no winner, correction A/B decision, threshold, confidence interval or hypothesis test
definitions.module_scope: 24 modules per representation per object are long-table observations, never independent seeds
definitions.normmatch_NA: paired matched delta is null unless both readouts are matched; seed mean requires all four objects; overall requires all 12 complete seeds
definitions.original_protocol: fixed comparisons only; weighting and NA aggregation are design candidates, not retroactive protocol changes
definitions.relative_error: abs(full-h32)/abs(full), null when full is zero; seed mean requires all four defined objects
definitions.sample_sd: sample standard deviation of 12 seed means, denominator 11
definitions.seed_estimator: four configured direction objects equally weighted within each seed; 12 seeds equally weighted
definitions.zero_removed: inactive_no_zero_direction raw readout retained; active-only within-seed means report explicit object denominators and are conditional descriptions

source_roles.T_full_h32: one-step linear predictions from fixed T mask; no new full-T training
source_roles.normmatched: read-only uniform LoRA effective update rescale; trained head unchanged
source_roles.original: already trained direction readout2048 at original update scale

source_warnings_preserved: direction raw bank has no explicit readout source/row hash; role is bound by frozen driver/model source and manifest
